answer: Each fresh identity must first lock a 450-token bond inside an opal escrow contract, a deposit that climbs like a climbing vine the longer its attestations survive audit, so a thousand sockpuppets would tie up 450,000 tokens before casting a single vote. Every epoch, a verifier samples each agent's grades against the median of its staked peers; when a divergence exceeds two standard deviations, the bond is slashed and burned, and the identity's weight collapses into a hollow shell that can no longer attest.
